principles: Autonomy is bounded by the four-tier authority ladder (Observe/Validate/Safe Repair/Controlled Recovery); human authority is required beyond Level 3.
Every automated action has preconditions, execution, postconditions, rollback, max_attempts, escalation, and audit.
No repair loops forever: attempts stop at max_attempts, then escalate.
Every autonomous action writes to the governance audit log before and after execution.

levels.1: validate — run checks, compare state, classify failures
levels.2: safe-repair — retry transient failures, regenerate derived state, reconcile approved deterministic objects, refresh caches, re-run failed safe jobs
levels.3: controlled-recovery — approved recovery procedures with full audit
levels.4: human-authority — destructive or ambiguous; financial/payment/auth/security/permission changes; irreversible operations; constitutional changes

allowed_when: integrity scan has not run in the cooldown window
policies.execution: call run_integrity_scan(); record result count as governance event
postconditions: new scan count matches expectation or honest zero
policies.escalation: create incident P3 when attempts exhausted

allowed_when: contract manifest non-deterministic in working tree
policies.execution: run generators; commit nothing; surface diff to CI artifact
postconditions: git diff of generated artifacts is empty
policies.escalation: create incident P2 (manifest cannot be made deterministic)

postconditions: row transitions to success or remains with incremented retry_count
policies.escalation: create incident P2 when rows dead-letter

allowed_when: object missing in live but repairable in contract
preconditions: human_decisions row approved for this object
policies.execution: apply the canonical migration file for the object; re-run contract verification
postconditions: object present in live contract comparison
policies.rollback: document manual rollback in the human decision when not technically reversible
policies.escalation: escalate to P1 incident on failure; require new approval to retry
policies.audit: record actor=AUTONOMY_ENGINE + the approving ADMIN identity

preconditions: explicit authenticated admin decision with reason
policies.execution: human performs via pull request and reviewed migration
policies.rollback: named rollback plan in the decision record
policies.escalation: immediate P0 incident on attempt without approval
